result.title: Are UFOs Real? Introducing Unified Factored Organizers
result.summary: Implicit in much research in deep learning is the assumption that if a network achieves low loss, then it must have learned a good representation of its training data. Recent work by Kumar et al. (2025, arXiv:2505.11581) questions this assumption, arguing that networks trained with conventional gradient descent achieve low loss despite learning fractured entangled representations (FER), leaving related concepts disconnected and unrelated concepts entangled inappropriately. Kumar et al. further show that dramatically better representations are possible: a network evolved through an open-ended, human-in-the-loop process learned unified factored representations (UFR) that capture the regularities of the domain far better than a counterpart with nearly identical outputs trained with conventional gradient descent. Inspired by UFR, this paper introduces unified factored organizers (UFOs), networks trained to model regularities in the representations of other networks. A network can then be trained both to achieve low loss on its task objective and to align its representations with the model learned by the UFO. Networks trained with UFOs are shown to learn qualitatively superior representations in an image-regression domain where representations are easily interpretable. To provide quantitative evidence for the impact of UFOs on representation learning, a transformer is trained with and without UFO regularization to grok a modular arithmetic problem set. When combined with weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 10x relative to weight decay alone. Without weight decay, UFOs can reduce the number of transformer training steps needed to grok by more than 100x relative to an unregularized baseline. If UFOs are real, they suggest a new paradigm where loss functions themselves are trained to learn an effective model of good representation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 unified factored organizers（UFOs）：先训练一个网络去建模其他网络表示中的规律，再把任务网络的内部表示与该校验器对齐并联合优化；在图像回归与模块算术 grokking 任务上报告表示质量提升和收敛步数大幅减少。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属通用表示学习、并非多模态推理，但其「用可训练组织器对内部表示施加表示级监督」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态训练目标、信息坍缩与轨迹贡献分配问题。
